open_questions: Deliverable (3) of the T027 ruling is unlanded and needs a follow-up unit: (i) acquisitionLaneOf walking UP to the nearest enclosing .versionless/work/<id>/baseline gated on walking THAT tree and matching the journalled archiveParity digest, four existing gates unchanged; (ii) reading the frontend root by lineage across the acquisition root and its immediate subdirectories with frontendRootBasis naming every candidate and each manifest's reading, refusing on zero or several; (iii) reading the identifier from the journal under the same five gates when package.json has no name, with idReadFrom naming it an operator declaration made at acquire time; and propagating the frontend root from ingest to analyze, era-cell, plan and apply in run.ts with both roots printed in the run record.
